review.feedback: English draft resting on a snapshot of the 18 citation counts of the latest quality-trend run at Demerzel commit 4b03838800dcd4894f1e026461979bff1d985ca8 (16 positive, 2 of the 18 hand-typed) and on a deterministic analysis whose 46 self-checks pass. Over all positive counts the power law is the worst of three fitted families (log-likelihood ratio -13.23 against the exponential), and on the 12-value tail it cannot be separated from an exponential. The synthetic samples that calibrate these statements use assumed parameters, and the hand-typed counts in use until 2026-09-13 would have given no decisive likelihood comparison, a goodness-of-fit p-value of 0.0805 and, by the share rule of the specification PSY-001 cites first, a power law that the counts at the pin no longer show, so the result depends on the counting instrument. Human subject review, learner trial, translation and publication remain pending.
